title: Immunofluorescence Assay for Detection of ZIKA Virus Envelope Protein
author: Elen Mello de Souza
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jqycmxw
materials: Follow the infection up to 72 hours.

steps.title: Seed Vero Cells
steps.instruction: Seed Vero cells on coverslips into a 24-well plate at a density of 2 x 10^5 cells/well.

steps.title: Infect Cells with ZIKA Virus
steps.instruction: Infect the cells with viral suspension to allow for virus adsorption.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µl of viral suspension at a multiplicity of infection (MOI) of 1

steps.title: Remove Non-Adsorbed Viral Particles
steps.instruction: Wash the cell monolayer 3 times with Phosphate-buffered saline (PBSx1).

steps.title: Collect Samples
steps.instruction: Remove two coverslips from the plate every 24 hours.

steps.title: Fix Cells
steps.instruction: Fix the cells using 500 µl of 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA) for 20 minutes at 4°C.

steps.title: Wash Coverslips
steps.instruction: Wash the coverslips 3 times with PBS.

steps.title: Permeabilize Cells
steps.instruction: Permeabilize the cells with 200 µl of 0.1% Triton X-100 diluted in PBS for 5 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash Coverslips
steps.instruction: Wash the coverslips 3 times with PBS.

steps.title: Block Non-Specific Binding
steps.instruction: Block non-specificity binding with 200 µl of 3% bovine serum albumin (Sigma-Aldrich) for 30 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash Coverslips
steps.instruction: Wash the coverslips 3 times with PBS.

steps.title: Incubate with Primary Antibody
steps.instruction: Incubate with 50 µl of mouse IgG2a monoclonal antibody anti-ZIKA virus envelope protein (4G2) diluted in PBS (1:4) for 60 minutes at 37°C.

steps.title: Wash Coverslips
steps.instruction: Wash the coverslips 3 times with PBS.

steps.title: Incubate with Secondary Antibody
steps.instruction: Incubate with 50 µl of secondary antibody Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) (Invitrogen) for 60 minutes at 37°C.

steps.title: Wash Coverslips
steps.instruction: Wash the coverslips 3 times with PBS.

steps.title: Stain Cell Nuclei
steps.instruction: Incubate with 50 µl of 10 μg/ml 4,6-diamidino-2-phenylindole (DAPI) (Sigma-Aldrich) diluted in PBS for 5 minutes at 37°C.

steps.title: Mount Coverslips
steps.instruction: Mount the coverslips with 10 µl of 2.5% 1,4-diazabicyclo(2,2,2)-octane (DABCO) (Sigma-Aldrich) to prevent loss of fluorescence.
